verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official, single-binary sentry-cli for Linux, macOS and Windows that runs non-interactively with Organization Tokens. It covers automation tasks such as creating and managing releases, uploading source maps and debug files, sending events, streaming logs, monitoring cron jobs, and uploading snapshots for GitHub status checks, which shows clear headless and CI-style use. A public API with an OpenAPI spec adds further programmatic access. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation (e.g. an official GitHub Action or CI setup guide), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
